versions.changelog:
Initial release of the conversational AI assistant for Greek accounting data.

- Introduces a natural language interface for querying and interacting with Greek accounting system data in English.
- Orchestrates queries and actions across all installed OpenClaw skills; does not duplicate or replace existing logic.
- Supports conversational context tracking and reference resolution within sessions.
- Handles information retrieval, workflow actions, and regulatory/explanation queries.
- Professional, concise response style designed for accounting firm environments.
- No external credentials required; works with local data and the OpenClaw LLM runtime.
